preview.fields: Existing closed fourteen-field CASE_INPUT_SCHEMA in FE js/bpay-next-case-preview.js and BE bpay-next-case-contract.js
preview.presentation: Original total and explicit entered tax only. No repayment, affordability, due date, payroll net or final bank cash estimate.

create.tax: Exactly one staff choice TAXABLE or NON_TAXABLE. Neither is preselected.
create.principal: Entered positive decimal text, at most two decimal places (whole pence), original 1024-byte bound; no floating-point normalization.
create.reason: Required Comment, nonblank <=2048 UTF-8 bytes and no NUL.
create.note: Optional Note, null when blank, otherwise <=2048 UTF-8 bytes and no NUL.
create.authority: Existing original command id plus identical native input/context Preview token; original accept/apply owns all money/ledger/queue behavior.
create.taxStages: Current creator1536 preserves PAYE TAXABLE GROSS_ADD and NON_TAXABLE NET_ADD. Non-taxable reimbursement fixed; canonical remaining/channel calculators retained. Umbrella Create independent of later CM-13a allocation.
create.receipt: Existing ACCEPTED_PENDING_CASE with original Case/command/sequence/replay; never funding or payout proof.

recovery.journal: Original Candidate-scoped .case-create.<candidate_id>; no parallel family journal.
recovery.unknown: Staff Try again sends exact original bytes and command only. No automatic mutation retry/new identity.
recovery.sameFamily: Restore CREDIT/MANUAL_CREDIT principal, explicit tax, Comment and Note only from original pending bytes.
recovery.otherFamily: Preserve original bytes; hide fresh form and empty footer, retain actual Candidate and existing instruction/header Close. No reinterpretation or new command.
recovery.accepted: Hide unavailable fresh terms; retain actual Candidate and original accepted identity. Existing Refresh reads only accepted Case/Candidate.

readback.scope: Original accepted candidate_id and case_id, existing cursor reader.
readback.return: Only validated matching Case/page triggers onCaseCreated and bpay_next result. Original controller completes the journal after callback; main suppresses legacy whole-Workbench refresh. FC02 later consumes targeted Case row.

excludedLaterOwners: FC-09 pre-activity edit and read-only restrictions
futureJoinedAcceptance: AUTHORED_NOT_RUN: GBP40 non-taxable due-once NET_ADD, persisted Case, original retry, queue/funding/payout/Draft and exact host update.
timing: Timing check moved to TEST after installation (owner 10/10/2026).
